Short Description (<=80): Fast video downloader, torrent client & private adblock browser. Resume files.
Full Description (<=4000):

- High-speed multi-threaded file downloader with parallel parts (up to 32 parts on Pro, 64 on Ultra)
- Smart download accelerator that speeds up file, video, and torrent transfers
- Reliable background download manager: pause, resume, and pick up broken links after app restarts or network drops
- Dead-link revival: refresh expired download URLs automatically

SMART WEB VIDEO DOWNLOADER & MEDIA SAVER
- Powerful web video downloader that detects downloadable videos, audio, and media streams as you browse
- Built-in video player with speed control, gesture seek, and Picture-in-Picture (PiP) to preview files before downloading
- Stream & playlist downloader: reassembles m3u8 and video streams into full offline MP4 files
- One-tap batch video downloader: grab multiple media files and links simultaneously
- Auto-organize: downloaded videos, music, and documents are automatically sorted into organized folders

PRIVATE BROWSER WITH BUILT-IN ADBLOCK
- Fast private browser with automatic ad blocker and popup blocker for clean, secure browsing
- Multi-tab browsing with tab groups, bookmarks, and persistent session recovery
- Reader mode, offline page saver, and custom element hiding for distraction-free reading
- Incognito privacy: your browsing history and downloaded files stay strictly on your local device

NATIVE TORRENT DOWNLOADER & MAGNET CLIENT
- Built-in torrent client to download torrents and magnet links directly to your device
- Multi-file torrent support: select specific files, pause, resume, and seed without extra apps
- Fast native P2P engine with custom download rules and speed limits

AUTOMATIC GOOGLE DRIVE CLOUD BACKUP
- Connect your Google account and auto-sync completed downloads to Google Drive
- Set flexible sync schedules: instant, every 15 minutes, hourly, or daily
- Dedicated Aurora cloud folder ensures your files are backed up and accessible from any phone or PC

EASY IMPORT & WI-FI FILE TRANSFER
- Import download queues and history from other Android download managers (JSON, backup files)
- Secure Folder & work-profile compatible
- Transfer files to your PC or Mac over local Wi-Fi with zero server intermediary

AURORA PRO — ONE-TIME UNLOCK
- 16 parallel downloads & 32 parts per file (Free: 3 downloads & 8 parts)
- Higher Google Drive sync limits (50 files/day)
- Unlimited adblock filter lists, tracker protection, and custom element rules
- Automatic dead-link revival, series auto-grab, and private vault

AURORA ULTRA — POWER USER SUITE
- 64 downloads at once & 64 parts per file
- Up to 1,000 Google Drive syncs daily
- Built-in media converter suite (downloaded on demand to avoid app bloat)

- Ad blocking operates exclusively within Aurora Browser and does not act as a system-wide VPN.
- Users are responsible for ensuring they have the legal right to download content from third-party sites.

Aurora's core is open source (GPL-3.0). Official Play Edition includes verified updates and optional Pro/Ultra features. Not affiliated with Google, YouTube, or third-party media platforms.
